Convergent evidence suggests that SFCAs may ameliorate metabolic defects secondary to mitochondrial abnormalities in PD. In addition, the gut-brain axis represents a bidirectional communication complex system involving the vagal and sympathetic nerves and humoral systems. Effects of SCFA on the brain may be indirect and/or direct. For example, fiber-induced SCFA production in the colon may result in vagal nerve-mediated changes affecting the brain.
